caption:
Receipt after shopping: A in the bin or B in a drawer? Comment A or B.

You don't have to type your groceries in. In WE.LIFE you take a photo of the receipt and nothing changes until you confirm. Your pantry then knows what's at home, and the shopping list for your meal plan subtracts what you already have.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. Your account is free. The link to WE.LIFE is in our bio @welife.world.

The images are AI-generated illustrations.

#mealplan #pantry #groceryshopping
